account: State assessment after querying the board: all seven corpus papers have complete, page-marked, ready_to_synthesize answers (Du positive, Smit null/contingent, Zhang matched-compute negative + heterogeneity, Lorenz and Choi for the social-influence pathway, Dung and Shapiro for the synthesis/merge stage), and the Smit-contradicts-Du link is recorded. Every remaining open question is corpus-unanswerable by construction: rz1, rz2, rq1, rq-choi-1, and rq-shapiro-merge each have acceptance conditions requiring a NEW matched-compute experiment that does not exist in papers/text, so further investigation has zero expected yield; the only available experiment adapter (text_statistics) has no decision value for the note; and the runtime explicitly reports no remaining work budget for synthesis, so the queued integration questions (work:003-synthesis, work:004-synthesis) cannot be executed. The highest-value bounded action is therefore to finish: deliver the complete, contradiction-preserving evidence base as the named support for the research note, and explicitly report every open question — the five identification gaps (which are precisely the D6 limits and the rz1/rz2-instantiating D7 experiment content) and the note-assembly demands that no executed answer covers.

action.rationale: These seven answers are the complete evidentiary corpus coverage demanded by D4 and contain, with file paths and ===== PDF PAGE N ===== markers, every element the research note requires: (1) the conflicting empirical poles to reconcile — Du 2023's debate-over-majority gains confounded by ~3x compute (answer:work:001-inv-du-debate, incl. its own boundary finding that no compute-matched comparison exists), Smit 2023's hyperparameter- and dataset-contingent null with the agreement-intensity sign flip (answer:work:002-inv-smit-mad-r2, linked contradicts Du), and Zhang 2025's matched-compute SC/CoT dominance plus the Heter-MAD result with the missing heterogeneous-SC control (answer:work:002-inv-zhang-when-r2); (2) the social-influence/conformity pathway from both sides — Lorenz 2011's bare-feedback diversity collapse without error reduction and Choi 2025's capability-dominated persuasion on ground-truth-free topics; (3) the formal constraints on the synthesis stage — Dung 1995 showing conflict adjudication is truth-neutral and symmetric ties are undecidable without external evidence (motivating retrieval as tie-breaker), and Shapiro 2011 showing merge rules are truth-neutral and stochastic LLM synthesis violates CRDT commutativity/idempotence conditions (grounding that consensus is not evidence of truth). No further bounded action can improve on this: the open raised questions require experiments outside the corpus, synthesis budget is exhausted per explicit runtime feedback, and the sole experiment adapter cannot bear on the research question. The note's thesis, causal model, predictions, limits, and preregistered design must be composed directly from these named answers, with the reported unresolved questions carried as the note's stated epistemic boundary per D6 and D8.
